edges: Tina Turner released multiple platinum albums including 'Foreign Affair' during the 1980s and 1990s.
Tina Turner released the single 'We Don't Need Another Hero (Thunderdome)' during the 1980s and 1990s.
Tina Turner's album 'Break Every Rule' achieved platinum status with 1,500,000 units sold.
Tina Turner released the single 'The Best' during the 1980s and 1990s.
Tina Turner performed the song 'GoldenEye' for the 1995 James Bond film of the same name.
